questions.question: Explain how the solar cell supplies energy to the pump through the controller and battery.
questions.reference_answer: The solar cell supplies current to the controller, which regulates current sent to the battery. The battery then supplies current to the pump.

required_evidence_units.requirement: The solar cell connects to the pump through controller and battery in order.
